location_note: City of David; no map reference.
notes: Areas D, E1-E3, G, J. Terraces and walls not eligible. Over 120 Rhodian stamped handles.

site_name: סקר ארכיאולוגי בצפון־מזרח ירושלים (North-East Jerusalem, Survey)
author: S. Gibson
location_note: c. 10 km2 between French Hill and Neve Yaʿaqov, incl. Tell el-Ful; about 85 sites, some with map references.
notes: Stone-vessel workshop of the 1st c. CE indicated by vessel fragments in the Hizma Muslim cemetery (no installation described; not coded). Lime kilns not coded.

site_name: ירושלים, סקר ארכיאולוגי ברמות (Jerusalem, Ramot, Survey)
author: R. Arav
location_note: Ramot development areas; sites with map references.
notes: Coins of John Hyrcanus and of the procurators at Ras el-Bad (site finds, not feature dates). Roads, monastery and tumulus not coded.

site_name: ירושלים, רמות - קבר מתקופת בית שני (Jerusalem, Ramot, Second Temple tomb)
author: J. Zias
location_note: Ramot; no map reference.

site_name: ירושלים, גת ליד ח׳ עין אל־תות (Jerusalem, winepress near Kh. ʿEin et-Tut)
author: Y. Gat
location_note: Near Kh. ʿEin et-Tut (HA 77 map ref 1663/1326); no map reference here.

author: A. Kloner, N. Feig
location_note: Rasco building area, Giloh areas E-F.

author: S. Gibson
location_note: West slope of Ras et-Tawil.

author: A. Kloner
location_note: East slope, east of the Truman Institute.

author: A. Kloner, Y. Gat
location_note: Between the Russian church, Bikur Holim hospital and the Heroism Museum; no map reference.

author: A. Kloner
location_note: Between Wolfson buildings and Migdale Megiddo; no map reference.

site_name: מערת קבורה מימי בית ראשון בצובה (Zova, First Temple burial cave)
author: A. Kloner
location_note: North of Tel Zova.

author: E. Netzer
location_note: Lower Herodium; no map reference.
notes: Byzantine churches with baptismal fonts (not eligible). The pool complex is mentioned only as known (not coded). CLAIM: reused Herodian ashlars suggest a dismantled monument with a Doric portico, perhaps over Herod's tomb cave (reconstruction; not coded).

author: Y. Porat
location_note: Ancient building near the ʿEn Gedi spring; no map reference.

author: R. Reich (excavation); S. Gibson (survey)
location_note: Hilltop above ʿIsawiya village.
notes: Later reuse (Late Roman or Byzantine) with a gabled cover over the lower part; a few bones and sherds in the covered space (not coded as a tomb: the report gives no function).

site_name: ירושלים, איזור כביש ירושלים - מעלה אדומים (Jerusalem - Maʿale Adummim road area)
author: G. Edelstein
location_note: Near ʿIsawiya. Both printed map references are written northing first (13440/17430, 13410/17440); used here as 17430/13440 and 17440/13410 (INFERENCE).

author: B. Pixner, D. Chen, S. Margalit
location_note: Protestant cemetery; no map reference.

author: A. Kloner
location_note: Ramot; the printed map reference (16828/31612) is garbled in the copy and not used.

author: G. Edelstein, S. Gibson
location_note: Southern slopes of Giv'at Massu'a; no map reference.
notes: MB I settlement layer, walls and a built stone installation of unknown use; later agricultural terraces. No feature of the eligible classes.

author: A. Kloner, Y. Gat
location_note: Three items: A (1719/1283), B (1724/1288), C (no map reference).
notes: Cisterns and installations near cave B are cited from HA 76 (earlier work, not coded).

author: H. Goldfus
location_note: Spur south of Qubbet en-Najma, overlooking the Roman road Taiyiba-Jericho.
notes: Fort with tower and courtyard, 5th-6th c. CE. No feature of the eligible classes ('installations' in the courtyard not described). No English version among the ESI 2 reports coded in phase 2.

site_name: ואדי אל־עין - מנזר ביזאנטי (Wadi el-ʿEin, Byzantine monastery)
author: N. Tanin (Benjamin survey)
location_note: Cliff east of el-Bira above Wadi el-ʿEin, a northern tributary of Nahal Mikhmas.

author: U. Dinur (Benjamin survey)
location_note: Village north-east of Jerusalem and its surroundings (about 1 km2).
notes: CLAIM: identification of ʿAnata with biblical Anathoth. A Roman tomb exposed in 1936 is earlier work (not coded).

author: D. Bahat
location_note: Dung Gate and Western Wall plaza; no map reference.
notes: Late Mamluk-Ottoman residential quarter; a Crusader installation known only from a mosaic fragment. No feature of the eligible classes.

author: H. Goldfus, Z. M. Gozlan
notes: Ottoman house with tabuns built over a Byzantine church. No feature of the eligible classes.

site_name: דיר מוכליק - כתובות יווניות (Deir Mukallik, Greek inscriptions)
author: Y. Patrich (cave survey)
location_note: Near Deir Mukallik (Theoctistus monastery) in Nahal Og (Wadi Mukallik); no map reference; located by the text (Nahal Og, gazetteer Z3).
notes: Eight Christian Greek inscriptions and crosses cut in the rock above the cistern.

site_name: מערת אל־מציה (נחל דרגות עליון) (El-Mazia Cave, Upper Nahal Deragot)
author: Y. Patrich (cave survey)
location_note: Below the village of Zaʿatara; the two forts at 1757/1202 and 1759/1200.
notes: Two small forts, a built path and a wall down to the wadi, probably a defence system for the cave occupants in the Bar Kokhba revolt (author's suggestion; buildings not coded).

site_name: עין גדי (ʿEn Gedi, Nahal ʿArugot aqueduct and tombs)
author: G. Hadas
location_note: Aqueduct in Nahal ʿArugot; no map reference.

author: I. Finkelstein
location_note: Desert fringe north-east of Jerusalem near Mukhmas.
notes: Single-period walled Iron Age site (11th to late 10th or early 9th c. BCE), four-room houses with monolith pillars. No feature of the eligible classes. The 1986 season is coded in phase 2 (ESI06-048-kh-ed-dawara).

author: O. Yogev
location_note: South bank of Nahal Zimrah, c. 1 km east of Tell el-Ful.
notes: Late Iron Age four-room house and building on terraces; MB I, MB II, late Iron and Hellenistic remains.

site_name: ירושלים, עיר דוד - 1985 (Jerusalem, City of David - 1985)
author: Y. Shiloh
location_note: City of David, Areas D2 and E1; no map reference.
notes: Hellenistic terraces (not earlier than the end of the 2nd c. BCE) not eligible.

author: S. Margalit, B. Pixner
location_note: Upper slope east of the old Protestant cemetery; no map reference.

author: E. Eisenberg, G. Edelstein
location_note: ʿEmeq Refaim site; no map reference.
notes: MB II village of houses on rock terraces and MB I houses; small pits in a courtyard (not described as cisterns). No feature of the eligible classes.

author: H. Hizmi
location_note: About 2 km north of el-ʿAuja, east of the Jordan Valley road.
notes: Byzantine church (6th-early 7th c. CE) and buildings; Herodian lamp fragments among the earliest finds. CLAIM: identification with Migdal Sennaa or Archelais. No feature of the eligible classes. No English version among the phase-2 ESI 5-6 reports.

author: R. Harper, D. Pringle
notes: Crusader castle destroyed 1191; village above. Built underground structure (not eligible).

author: R. P. Harper, D. Pringle
location_note: Zova; the castle's map reference (1620/1325) is printed in the first season's report (HA 89), not here.
notes: Crusader castle, Byzantine church mosaic below it, Persian yhd seal impressions in fills. No English version among the phase-2 ESI 7-8 reports.

author: R. P. Harper, D. Pringle
location_note: Zova (HA 89 map reference 1620/1325); no map reference here.

author: G. Hadas
location_note: ʿEn Gedi shore of the Dead Sea; no map reference.
notes: Three stone anchors, one tied to a double rope (radiocarbon 4th-3rd c. BCE). No feature of the eligible classes.

author: R. Reich, E. Shukron, Y. Billig
location_note: c. 100 m south-west of the Old City wall, upper Hinnom valley slope.
notes: CLAIM: the crypt may be the common grave 'Mamilla' of the Christians killed in 614 CE. Unused Byzantine lamps hidden in a bench of the chapel (coded as a concealed group).

site_name: ירושלים - שכונת עזרת תורה (Jerusalem, ʿEzrat Torah)
author: Z. Greenhut
S. Gibson
location_note: Sataf; no map reference.

site_name: המערה ׳התלויה׳ של חריטון (The 'Suspended' Cave of Chariton)
author: Y. Hirschfeld
location_note: South cliff of Nahal Teqoa (Wadi Khureitun), c. 800 m south of the monastery of Chariton; no map reference; zone from the gazetteer name (Chariton, Z3).

site_name: דרך קדומה בצפון מדבר יהודה (Ancient Road in the Northern Judean Desert)
author: O. Sion
toc_item: HA97-058-1: Ancient Road in the Northern Judean Desert
location_note: Survey of c. 15 km of the Nabi Musa-Jerusalem road between the Jerusalem-Jericho road and Nahal Og; eastern ascent 18900/13265 to Ras el-Mashhad 18765/13275, western ascent 18525/13265 to 18465/13280. The first reference falls in Z2, the other three in Z3; the quarry cuttings lie on the terrace of the eastern ascent (position between the first two references).
notes: Road (5 m terrace, retaining walls, flint paving, cairns) ascribed by the author to the end of the Mamluk period, probably in use already in the Roman period; lime pit 9 m in diameter used by the road builders (not an eligible class).

author: Y. Meitlis
location_note: Wadi Zimra (Jerusalem group heading); no map reference in this report (the reference 17396/13637 on the same pages belongs to Pisgat Ze'ev).
notes: Middle Bronze, Intermediate Bronze and Iron Age farmstead site; Area C1/D sherds also Roman and Byzantine.

site_name: ירושלים - פיסגת זאב (דיר ע׳זאלי) (Jerusalem, Pisgat Ze'ev, Deir Ghazali)
author: R. Avner, S. Atzmon, A. Sabriego
notes: Monastery founded in the 6th or late 5th c. CE; phase 2 (late 6th-7th c.) inn; abandoned in the 8th c. CE.

site_name: ירושלים - החומה השלישית (Jerusalem, The Third Wall)
author: V. Tzaferis, A. On, N. Feig, Y. Rapiano, S. Wexler
location_note: South of the Mandelbaum Gate, between Sheikh Jarrah and the Old City wall; no map reference in this report.
notes: Layer 3: the 'Third Wall' (1st c. CE) and a tower; a group of iron quarrying wedges on the rock in Area B (not coded as a cache: not described as concealed).

site_name: ירושלים - רחוב השלשלת (א) (Jerusalem, Street of the Chain A)
author: R. Abu Riya

site_name: ירושלים - רחוב השלשלת (ב) (Jerusalem, Street of the Chain B)
author: L. Gershuni
notes: Wilson's Arch summit exposed; street and the vault beneath it dated to the post-Herodian Early Roman period (fills of the early 1st c. CE). The round reservoir, the closed cistern and the Ottoman sabil to which the channels lead are named, not described or dated, and are not coded.

author: G. Avni, Z. Greenhut
location_note: East of the Akeldama monastery, road from Abu Tor to Silwan.
notes: Ossuaries (one with a Greek inscription, one signed by a craftsman from Beirut), stone doors with iron bolt, wooden coffins, sarcophagus; Byzantine mass burial in cave 2.

site_name: ירושלים - תלפיות מזרח (יער השלום) (Jerusalem, East Talpiyot, Peace Forest)
author: Z. Greenhut
notes: Cave 1 ossuaries inscribed 'Yehosef bar Qayafa' and other names; coin of Agrippa I in a skull.

site_name: סקר חוות בצפון יהודה (איזור ביתר) (Farmstead Survey in Northern Judea, Betar area)
author: D. Amit
toc_item: HA97-077-1: Farmstead Survey in Northern Judea
location_note: c. 2 km2 around Kh. Jarish; three Iron II farmsteads at 1598/1234, 1618/1239 and 1622/1241; the only eligible feature is in the farm at 1618/1239.

author: D. Amit
location_note: Spur above Wadi Fukin; the report notes that maps mark the ruin 400 m north of its true place.
notes: Small Ottoman village.

site_name: חורבת הלל (ח׳ הילאל) (H. Hillel, Kh. Hilal)
author: D. Amit
location_note: c. 1 km north-west of Kefar 'Etzyon, on the new road to Bat 'Ayin.
notes: Layer 1: Jewish estate founded under Herod and destroyed in the Bar Kokhba revolt (Bar Kokhba coin, stone vessels, burnt destruction). Layer 2: Byzantine winepress and storehouse. Cisterns, burial caves, a winepress and rock-cut installations are listed in the layer-1 paragraph as found around the built area without their own dating; coded unknown except the two burial caves the report assigns to the Iron Age.

site_name: ירושלים - פסגת זאב (מזרח א׳) (Jerusalem, Pisgat Ze'ev East A)
author: J. Seligman
location_note: Ras Abu Ma'aruf, c. 900 m east of Tell el-Ful.
notes: A covered pit of unclear function north of the Area 13 winepress is not coded.

site_name: ירושלים - פסגת זאב ד׳ (Jerusalem, Pisgat Ze'ev D)
author: Y. Nadelman
location_note: Between Pisgat Ze'ev and 'Anata.
notes: Persian-period fortress (yhd coins) continuing into the Early Roman period, destroyed probably in 70 CE (Year 4 coin of the Revolt); Byzantine lime pit.

site_name: ירושלים - פסגת זאב (שכונת ׳בנה ביתך׳) (Jerusalem, Pisgat Ze'ev, Bne Beitkha)
author: E. Shukron, A. Sabriego
location_note: Hilltop c. 6 km north-east of Jerusalem.
notes: Farmhouse with enclosure wall; pottery, stone vessels and bronze coins of the Second Temple period, none later than Alexander Jannaeus; three ink ostraca.

site_name: ירושלים - ביה״ס לשוטרים (Jerusalem, Police Training School)
author: S. Gudovitz
location_note: Ammunition Hill, beside the Police Training School; excavated January 1969, first published here.

author: R. Reich, E. Shukron, Y. Billig
location_note: Mamilla Area A3 and Rehov Botta (French consulate; slope to the Hinnom valley); no map reference in this report.

author: A. Maeir
location_note: Below the Old City wall, from the citadel moat northward.
notes: Area B1-2: corner of massive walls of the first half of the 1st c. BCE (late Hasmonean fortification or large building), not an eligible class.

site_name: ירושלים - שדרות בן צבי (Jerusalem, Ben Zvi Blvd.)
author: S. Gudovitz
location_note: Junction of Ben Zvi Blvd. and Ruppin St.; excavated April 1969, first published here.

author: A. Zehavi
location_note: Spur south of Manahat (Malha); sounding at Kh. er-Ras 16720/12810.

author: E. Eisenberg
location_note: Nahal Refa'im (Manahat); no map reference in this report.
notes: Intermediate Bronze (layer III) and Middle Bronze II (layer II) villages.

author: R. Ovadiah
location_note: Two hills with cairns; the report map reference is printed out of order; map_ref used is cave 1 (16641/12845); other features have their own references.
notes: Five one-room buildings perhaps Intermediate Bronze (or watchtowers); surface sherds Iron Age, Roman and Byzantine.

author: S. Margalit
location_note: Old City, street over the cardo; excavated February 1977, first published here; no map reference.
notes: Four soundings at cardo columns built into late medieval shops; no feature of the eligible classes.

author: G. Hadas
location_note: Tomb damaged by the paving of road 90 ('Ein Feshkha-'En Gedi).
